content: {"summary":"Users report that initiating a download from the store stalls at a “Working” status and never appears in the ready‑to‑download list, preventing any progress and causing significant frustration for large titles. [#tk_122599,#tk_2962992]\nSeveral complaints describe the installer closing immediately or not entering the queue, leaving games uninstalled and requiring a full reinstall, especially for large titles again. [#tk_505514,#tk_2961522]\nErrors like “installation stopped” at percentages, “installation failed”, or deletion after a cancelled update occur. [#tk_570273,#tk_891159,#tk_903417]"}
